summary: RFID PPS (polyphenylene sulfide) laundry chips are ultra-compact UHF RFID transponders encapsulated in Fortron / Ryton / Torelina-grade PPS thermoplastic resin for permanent textile embedding. PPS is the semi-crystalline high-performance polymer of choice for industrial-laundry service — it survives 200+ tunnel-wash cycles at 95 °C per ISO 15797 + ISO 6330 + ISO 3175 industrial-washing / dry-cleaning qualification, 80 °C tumble-drying, tunnel-finisher pressing at 180 °C, alkaline + chlorine + oxygen + peracetic wash-chemistry, and perc + hydrocarbon dry-cleaning solvents. Anchors: EN ISO 20471 hi-vis workwear + EN ISO 13688 PPE + NFPA 2112 FR-uniform + OEKO-TEX Standard 100 + STeP + bluesign + EU Ecolabel + EN 14065 RABC biocontamination-control healthcare + TRSA HLAC Hygienically Clean Healthcare + Food + Hospitality + AAMI PB70 + ASTM F1671 viral-penetration + IEC 60068-2-14 thermal-cycling. Ultra-small form-factors 7-18 mm for invisible sewn-in / heat-sealed / pouched integration across uniform-rental (Aramark, Cintas, UniFirst, Alsco, Prudential, Mission Linen), healthcare-linen (CHI, HCA, HSS, Encompass), hospitality + cleanroom (semiconductor, pharma, food-processing). Chip options: Impinj M750/M770/M775 Autotune + NXP UCODE 9/9xe/DNA for bulk tunnel-reader 100+ garments/second throughput via Kannegiesser + Milnor + Jensen + Tolkar + Ellis + Braun tunnel-wash systems with Impinj Speedway R700 + xArray + Zebra FX9600 + CSL CS468 portal infrastructure.

sections.title: Why barcode, sewn-in label, silicone button and sticker RFID fails in industrial-laundry tunnel programmes
bullets: Sewn-in barcode + QR labels become unreadable after 20-30 wash cycles as thermal-transfer + flexographic print fades + fabric frays + ink flakes off. Requires relabelling campaigns at $0.50-1.00 per garment in labour + throughput-loss alone — on a 100,000-garment fleet that's $50,000-$100,000 per relabelling cycle, triggered 10-20× over the garment's 5-7-year lifecycle.

Silicone button tags (non-PPS) swell + leach plasticiser + lose read-range after 50-80 ISO 15797 tunnel-wash cycles at 95 °C + alkaline wash-chemistry pH 10-12. Acceptable for residential-laundry applications but fails in TRSA-accredited commercial laundries processing 50,000-500,000 garments / day.

Adhesive sticker + patch RFID delaminates within 15-40 wash cycles when exposed to tunnel-washer mechanical agitation, G-extractor centrifugal force (300-500 g), tumble-dryer 80 °C + tunnel-finisher 180 °C press + dry-cleaning solvents (perc + hydrocarbon).

Rigid PCB + FR-4 hard-housed RFID breaks at fabric folding points during tunnel-finisher pressing + creates wearer-discomfort hard-points that fail EN ISO 13688 ergonomics + innocuousness + EN ISO 20471 wearer-comfort + OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132 PPE clothing requirements.

Non-PPS thermoplastic alternatives (PP, ABS, PC, nylon) either melt at tunnel-finisher pressing temperatures (>160 °C) or stress-crack under repeated wash-chemistry exposure (chlorine + peracetic + alkaline) + fail OEKO-TEX Standard 100 + REACH SVHC + ZDHC MRSL textile chemical-safety qualification for contact with skin-facing workwear.

sections.title: Proud Tek PPS polyphenylene sulfide thermoplastic UHF RFID architecture
bullets: PPS (polyphenylene sulfide) is a semi-crystalline high-performance engineering thermoplastic with glass transition Tg 88 °C + melting point 285 °C + continuous-service rating 200-220 °C. Commercial grades Fortron 1140L4 (Celanese), Ryton R-7 (Solvay) + Torelina A900 (Toray) — all 40 % glass-fibre-filled — deliver the mechanical + chemical + thermal envelope required for ISO 15797 tunnel-wash service.

Injection-moulded PPS encapsulation creates a hermetically sealed package protecting the UHF inlay (chip + strap + antenna-substrate) from water, detergent alkaline-pH 10-12, oxygen + chlorine + peracetic-acid bleach, tunnel-finisher 180 °C press, tumble-dryer 80 °C, G-extractor 500 g centrifuge + mechanical agitation through 200+ cycles per ISO 15797 Procedure 7 + 8.

Impinj Monza M750 / M770 / M775 + NXP UCODE 9 / 9xe / DNA + Alien Higgs-9 chip options — all with 96-bit EPC SGTIN / GIAI / GRAI + 32-96 B user memory. M750/M770/M775 Autotune auto-compensates fabric + body-proximity dielectric detuning — delivering consistent read-range across dry + wet + bundled garment states.

Ultra-compact form-factors: button disc 10 × 3 mm (baseline), micro button 7 × 2.5 mm (delicate), rod stick 18 × 6 × 2.5 mm (heavy-duty coverall), flex-edge lozenge 22 × 6 × 2 mm (contoured pocket), heat-seal patch 30 × 15 × 1.5 mm (iron-on + ultrasonic-weld), fabric-tab loop 15 × 5 × 3 mm (decorative sew-through). All invisible to wearer when integrated per manufacturer recommended location.

Chemical-resistance tested per ASTM D543 + ISO 175: aliphatic + aromatic hydrocarbons, IPA + ethanol, 10 % HCl + 20 % NaOH alkaline, 150 ppm chlorine + 5-8 % hydrogen peroxide + peracetic-acid CIP chemistry, perc (tetrachloroethylene) + hydrocarbon dry-cleaning solvents + fabric-softener + optical-brightener residue. UL 94 V-0 flame-retardant + NFPA 2112 FR workwear + FDA 21 CFR 177.2490 food-contact grades available.

sections.title: Six ultra-small PPS laundry-chip form-factor SKUs + textile integration methods
bullets: Button disc 10 × 3 mm — baseline seam / hem / waistband / collar-fold / label integration. Sewn into a small fabric pouch or heat-sealed patch + sewn through 2 × 1.5 mm holes. Invisible to wearer + does not affect garment drape, fit or comfort per EN ISO 13688 ergonomic requirement.

Micro button 7 × 2.5 mm — delicate garment integration (silk liner, scrubs, lightweight uniform, swim-trunk, cleanroom-garment). Ultra-low-mass minimises fabric-deformation + wearer-perception. Chip-option: Impinj M750 (lowest-mass Autotune).

Rod / stick 18 × 6 × 2.5 mm — heavy-duty coverall + FR workwear + uniform-pants waistband double-seam integration. Elongated form allows higher-gain antenna for bulk-tunnel 4-6 m read-range + multi-layer bundle penetration.

Flex-edge lozenge 22 × 6 × 2 mm — rounded-contour integration for pocket-liner + waistband-facing sew-in. No stress-concentration at corner. For sport-uniform, outdoor-workwear + retail-uniform applications where wearer-contact is frequent.

Heat-seal patch 30 × 15 × 1.5 mm — iron-on thermoplastic hot-melt adhesive (80-130 °C / 15-30 s) + ultrasonic-weld (20-40 kHz). Eliminates sewing labour cost — 3-5 cents per tag installation vs 10-15 cents per sewn button. For hi-vis workwear + FR coverall + cleanroom-garment programmes.

Fabric-tab loop 15 × 5 × 3 mm with 20 × 5 mm textile tab — sewn through decorative fabric tab at waistband / collar / placket / hem. Decorative integration + also accessible for NFC tap-verify by inspector without disturbing garment.

dataHighlight.text: ISO 15797 defines industrial washing + finishing procedures for testing workwear — Procedure 7 (95 °C) + Procedure 8 (85 °C) are the reference wash-chemistry + temperature + agitation profiles for commercial laundry PPE qualification. EN 14065 defines biocontamination-control RABC (Risk Analysis Biocontamination Control) management system for laundry-processed textiles in healthcare + nursing-home + pharma cleanroom. TRSA HLAC Hygienically Clean Healthcare / Food Safety / Hospitality / FR is the North American commercial-laundry accreditation body — quarterly microbiological testing + documented quality-management. OEKO-TEX Standard 100 + STeP + bluesign certify product-level + site-level + supply-chain textile chemical-safety. PPS polyphenylene sulfide thermoplastic is the only RFID-encapsulation material simultaneously qualified across ISO 15797 industrial-wash, EN 14065 RABC biocontamination, TRSA HLAC accreditation, OEKO-TEX + STeP + bluesign chemical-safety, AAMI PB70 + ASTM F1671 healthcare-barrier + NFPA 2112 + EN ISO 20471 + EN ISO 13688 PPE workwear regulatory frameworks.

faq.question: How is the PPS chip attached to the garment?
faq.answer: Five attachment methods match the six form-factor SKUs: (1) button disc 10 × 3 mm + micro button 7 × 2.5 mm + rod 18 × 6 × 2.5 mm are sewn into a small fabric pouch or heat-sealed patch + sewn in place at seam / hem / waistband / collar-fold / label location, (2) flex-edge lozenge 22 × 6 × 2 mm sews into rounded-contour pocket-liner or waistband-facing, (3) heat-seal patch 30 × 15 × 1.5 mm iron-ons via thermoplastic hot-melt adhesive at 80-130 °C / 15-30 s or ultrasonic-welds at 20-40 kHz (no sewing labour), (4) fabric-tab loop 15 × 5 × 3 mm with 20 × 5 mm textile tab sews through decorative fabric tab at waistband / collar / placket / hem. Attachment location + method is validated per garment type + wash-profile. All attachments are invisible to the wearer + do not affect garment drape, fit or comfort per EN ISO 13688 ergonomic + innocuousness requirements.

faq.question: How many wash cycles does the PPS chip survive?
faq.answer: The Proud Tek PPS laundry chip is qualified for 200+ industrial wash cycles at 95 °C per ISO 15797 Procedure 7 + ISO 6330 Procedure E2H tumble-dry at 80 °C + ISO 3175-2 perchloroethylene dry-cleaning. In hotel-linen applications running ISO 15797 Procedure 8 (85 °C gentler wash-programme), chips have been validated to 300+ cycles. Warranty SLA: 60 months + ≥99.5 % read-rate retention after 200 ISO 15797 cycles. For healthcare-linen SKU, additional qualification covers gamma-sterilisation 25-40 kGy + EtO ethylene-oxide sterilisation per ISO 11135 + steam-autoclave per ANSI/AAMI ST79.

faq.question: What is the read range when chips are inside bundled garments going through a tunnel-wash system?
faq.answer: Individual chips provide 1-2 m read range with a standard UHF handheld reader (Zebra RFD8500 + Honeywell IH-25 + Impinj STID R420). In bulk-reading tunnel-wash scenarios where bagged + bundled garments pass through a tunnel-reader portal on conveyor at 0.5 m/s, the system reads 100-200 tagged garments simultaneously through multiple fabric layers. Read accuracy in Kannegiesser PowerTrans + Milnor CBW + Jensen Senking installations exceeds 99.5 % at conveyor speeds up to 0.5 m/s. Impinj Speedway R700 + xArray overhead portal + Zebra FX9600 + CSL CS468 are the most common tunnel-reader OEMs. Impinj M750/M770/M775 Autotune auto-compensates fabric dielectric + body-proximity detuning, maintaining read-range consistency across wet + dry + bundled states.

faq.question: Does the PPS chip pass OEKO-TEX Standard 100, STeP, bluesign and OSHA textile-safety requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. Proud Tek PPS laundry chips are certified to OEKO-TEX Standard 100 (product-level harmful-substance certification covering Annex 6 restricted substances + ZDHC MRSL v3.1 + REACH SVHC + California Prop 65 + TSCA), STeP by OEKO-TEX (site-level Sustainable Textile Production certification), bluesign SYSTEM + bluesign APPROVED Chemistry qualification, EU Ecolabel Commission Decision 2014/350/EU, and ZDHC Roadmap to Zero Programme. The 40 % glass-filled Fortron / Ryton / Torelina PPS resin + injection-moulded encapsulation + integrated chip + adhesives + textile carrier-pouch all certified free of restricted substances. For healthcare-linen SKU, additional AAMI PB70 Level 1-4 barrier + ASTM F1671 viral-penetration + EN 14065 RABC + TRSA HLAC Hygienically Clean accreditation qualification is available.
